law: Visual-law fields describe transferable perceptual mechanisms. Catalyst/reaction/dependence remain UNKNOWN unless source-chat/prompt evidence is separately joined.

items.visual_law: Successive frames convert a boundary into a traversable passage while preserving a central address.
items.app_test: Keep one object identity through nested apertures; compare orientation/re-entry against a flat list.

items.visual_law: Distance and ring phase make center/periphery and nested reach directly perceptible.
items.app_test: Rotate two coordinate rings; mismatch should appear as interference and quiet when the addressed relation aligns.

items.visual_law: A route remains recoverable through occlusion and depth when continuity cues survive local detours.
items.app_test: Compare route recovery with and without a continuous perceptual cue under equal branch clutter.

items.visual_law: Distributed routing becomes legible when local loops, voids and junctions compose into one field rather than a list of edges.
items.app_test: Use tile-wise phase mismatch to reveal whether a continuous route can be perceived before explicit adjacency inspection.

items.visual_law: When a frame is wrong, rotate the coordinate frame rather than rewriting the represented world.
items.app_test: Hold source geometry fixed; rotate only projection coordinates. Interference should fall as phase/orientation alignment improves.

items.visual_law: Classification becomes useful when distinctions are arranged as a passage with visible consequences rather than a detached legend.
items.app_test: Compare a classification-as-route interaction to a conventional table for error recovery and source retention.

items.visual_law: Concentric attention pressure can expose a center, trap, or escape condition by changing density toward a focal basin.
items.app_test: Map increasing constraint density to radial interference and test whether the exit remains perceptible without explanatory chrome.

items.visual_law: A return can preserve fragments of the prior field while reopening a forward passage.
items.app_test: Show prior-route afterimage only after RETURN; verify that residue aids re-entry without becoming current-state authority.
